title: Tranfusion
description: Solution: - Obtain all blood bags. - Place the [Sarah Watson Blood Bag](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=948458) next to the chart reading 'regular pulse and head wound' - Place the [Matthew Clark Blood Bag](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=948508) next to the chart reading 'verbal - confused and motor / reaction - obeys commands' - Place the [George McEwan Blood Bag](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=948502) next to the chart reading '2nd / 3rd' - Activate the switch next to the door.

title: Blood Types
description: Solution: - Remember that Simon's blood type is A+, seen on his medical wristband. - As seen on the [A+ Plaque](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=948533), the compatible blood types are O-, O+, A-, and A+. - The blood bags in the previous room show the patients' blood types. - Rotate the dials so that there are links from HM, TF and SW to Ordell. - Press the Ordell button.

title: Black Box
description: Solution: - Grab the [Disk Case Key](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950593) and use it to unlock the [Disk Case](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950590) here, retrieving [Floppy Disk x3](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950594) - Unlock another disk case in Atlas Computers to retrieve ["Fix-A-Disk!" Software](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950599) - Return to the computer, insert Fix-a-Disk, then insert Floppy Disk 2 of 3. Run the software. - Insert disk 1, 2, and 3 in order. - Turn on the printer by pressing the button. - Print out the MANUAL.EML's attachment, [Reciprocating Compressor](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950600) - Use code 9-5-6 to unlock the black box.

title: Black Box
description: Solution: - Take [Tape: Today](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950619), [The Code Today](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950617), and [Tape: Yesterday](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950622); insert the latter into the tape player and hit 'play'. - Grab [The Code Before](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950701) and [Tape: Tomorrow](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950700); play the latter. - Grab [The Code After](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950702) and [Tape: Do Not Play](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950703); play the latter. - Grab the [Back Door Key](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950704) then play Tape: Today. - Unlock [5 Upper Brae Back Door](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950615) and grab the [Ammonite Disk](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950705) - Play Tape: Yesterday and put the disk into the computer's disk reader to receive [Current Count](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950706) - Play Tape: Today one last time, and insert code 129 to open the black box.

title: Black Box
description: Solution: - Read the [Lamenting Poem](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=950790). - A painting in the bedroom shows seven boats. - A sketch in the next bedroom shows three arches. - Downstairs, there's a total of six children in the pictures. - Insert 7-3-6 to open the box.

title: Generator
description: Solution: - Grab the [Generator Key](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=952645#L) and put it in the front panel - Go around the back, and pull only the rightmost lever - Return to the front and pull the main lever

title: Projector
description: Solution: - Take the [Access Card - Level 3/4](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=952862) and use it to unlock a [P.R. Door](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=952878) on floor 3 - Go upstairs, take the [CEG Storeroom Key](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953230), and use it to reach the [Projector Bulb](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953238) - With the [CEG Checkout Sheet](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953237), unlock the [Finance Door](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=952875) and take the [Projector Lens](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953245) - Insert both parts and press the 'on' switch. - Head to the mezzanine to collect the [Projector Slides](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953309) - Insert them in this order: - 1 / D - 2 / F - 3 / B - 4 / C - 5 / E - 6 / A - Press Play.

title: Console
description: Solution: - Use the elevator to go up a floor and grab the [Controller Key](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953325) - Go back down to ground level and grab the [Reference Sheet](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953318) - Find the control panel, insert the key, and input code A-5-D-7 to disable the alarm - Next, go to the command console on the other side of the wheel and input code E-3-E-3 - Turn the wheel next to you so the pipes align - Repeat this process on each floor; check the pipe from all angles to make sure it lines up - Return to the ground floor; press 'Flow Test' and then 'IGNITE'

title: Remote Systems Control
description: Solution: - Turn on both switches, then turn to camera 005 to see '2 5 4' written on Valve B. - Press the buttons in screenshot #1 above, then press enter. - Turn to camera 000 to see '103' written on filter unit A. - Press the buttons in screenshot #2 above, then press enter. - Take the [AUX Key](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953430), use it to open the [AUX Door](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953348), and solve the [AUX](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953436) puzzle. - Press the buttons in screenshot #3 above. - Turn to camera 002 to see '781' written on the console. - Press the buttons in screenshot #4 above, then press enter. - Turn to camera 004 to see '592' written above the door. - Press the buttons in screenshot #5 above, then press enter. - For additional supplies, you can repeat this process with doors: - [047](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953443), [621](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953444), [793 ](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953445) - Go down to the basement and turn [Valve F](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953442). - Take the [Clamp Release Procedure](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953458), and turn your attention to the [Clamp Controls](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953437).

title: AUX
description: Solution: - Insert the [AUX Disk](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953434) into the computer's disk reader to receive the [Auxiliary Lines](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953435) clue. - Start with the pipes facing the computer screen; look for any levers with one paint line nearby, then pull them to match the clue's "1" line: - | _ | | _ | _ | | - If you've done it right, the light will turn green. - Repeat the process with line 2; it starts just above the first line's starting point. - | _ _ _ | _ _ | | - And again with line 3; it starts by the door, and has some paint splotches a fair distance from its levers. - _ | | | _ | _ | - Once all three lights are green, head back to the [Remote Systems Control](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953428) puzzle.

title: Clamp Controls
description: Solution: - Adjust Pressure Control (bottom left) to 'Set' - Set Notify switches (top right) to both be 'On' - Set Tension (top left) to both be 'Intermediate' - Set Run Off (top right) to 'Disengaged' - Adjust 'Intubate Flow' (bottom left) to 'None' - In Clamp Connection (middle-left), type 'D71' - Toggle Report switches (middle-right) to be On - Off - On - Off - Off - On - Adjust Power (bottom-right) so Battery One is B, and Battery Two is C - Light protection switches seemingly don't matter, so press 'Release'. - Use the [Valve](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953459).

title: Hotel Room
description: Solution: - Tune into the [18th January](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953490) signal and examine the [Room Service Card](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-townfall/maps/st-amelia?locationIds=953487) - Interact with the dial on the door and input 18 - JANUARY - 1996
